notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]What we've been working on[/h1]

This is it! It's release week for [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b]!

All QA testing, bug fixing and main marketing plans have been completed!

From last week we had 2 major things to fix, these were:
[list]
[*] The Windmill Cube didn't trigger complete when it was done
[*] Exiting the game with some cubes having only 1 move left would mark the save as complete, preventing you actually completing the cube without starting again
[/list]

We are happy to say both of these issues have been fixed and are ready for release!

[h2]Merch![/h2]
Just in time for release, we have had the poster for [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b] delivered so we can confirm it is good for sale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/79224bf119d39572746435aa35f195ed1466f78c.jpg[/img]

Check it out on our website [url=https://www.toastielabs.co.uk/shop]here[/url] if you want to purchase your very own game merch to support us further! <3

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Only a tiny bit of marketing is left!

We have the final posts for the rest of the week (you may have noticed our countdown on Twitter) and we are in talks with various content creators to hopefully get some other perspectives on the game!

As well as this, we are recording and editing a (hopefully) entertaining release day broadcast video!

Make sure you add the game to your wishlist to buy the game as soon as it is released!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868060

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]What we've been working on[/h1]

Yet another week closer to release and we are adding the final changes to [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b] 

The majority of puzzles have been completed with only 2 tricky ones left to finish! The Barrel cube and Windmill cube are all that are left to complete once I can figure out the trick!

The 2x2 Mirror cube issue reported last week has been resolved with a new 3D model and has been tested to confirm the puzzle works: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/e73f59ffdec8495cec6b7980c5fa6e0ccfbb24be.png[/img]

As well as this, we have spent time this week incorporating your feedback from the Next Fest Demo, these changes are:
[list]
[*] An option for unrestricted vertical rotation
[*] An option for quicker shuffling animations
[*] A updated game flow for when you complete a puzzle
[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Same as last week - more Marketing and more QA

We have contacted a news reporting organisation this week with hopes of getting an exclusive review - other than this we are prepped for a full marketing rollout on Friday where we will be contacting various organisations and content curators to get some potential collaborations. 

QA will continue all week to iron out as many potential bugs as possible before release. We will be hosting one last live stream on Friday before the final release day live stream on the 8th of July!

Make sure you add the game to your wishlist to keep up-to-date with the news!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868060

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]What we've been working on[/h1]

We have had a whirlwind of a week with the Steam Next Fest! 

We spent numerous hours last week testing the game. A lot of the bug fixes previously implemented have been re-tested with most of them being marked as fixed! Only the confusing FPS setting issue remains. 

Other than this, we got many more cubes completed, now 60% of the 20 puzzles have been successfully finished - only 2 puzzles have led to things to correct.
[olist]
[*] The save file for the 3x3 Void Cube was marked as completed after closing and re-opening the game when 2 blocks weren't in the correct place
[*] The 2x2 Mirror Cube has identical pieces which leads to the puzzle looking complete when it technically isn't
[/olist]

The save file issue will take a little digging to find the cause but the 2x2 mirror cube is being corrected by slightly editing the 3D model of the blocks.


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
In short, more QA and Marketing!

We have spent the start of this week refining our marketing plan for the build-up to release. We are prepping and/or beginning our contact with news websites and content curators so keep an eye out for potential posts about Who Shuffled My Shapes from other sources!

We have recruited some 3rd party help with QA but we will be continuing the in-house QA which we will be showcasing on Fridays Livestream - Livestream re-runs will be shown throughout the weeks in the runup to release

Make sure you add the game to your wishlist to keep up-to-date with the news!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868060

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]What we've been working on[/h1]

It's another week closer to the game's release date and it's another week of progress made on Who Shuffled My Shapes?

The big news this week is that we have re-submitted the game build to Valve for review!

Our previous submission came back with some recommended changes that we have now implemented - the most important of these being a drop-down setting for language select as the game is localised to a number of languages.


Alongside this, the other changes we have made to the game are all from the feedback from the QA Livestreams we have been hosting at the end of every working week - a button to flip the cube over along with bug fixes to cube controls and the Windmill cube save files have been corrected.

Join our stream on Friday to see these changes in effect!


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Another week of QA is due before the big Next Fest Demo release on Monday the 13th!

We are very excited for you all to get hands-on experience with the game yourselves! Any feedback is more than welcome!

Make sure you add the game to your wishlist and get involved with the Next Fest!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/a8e1a041593b926ed33e1a1d999b4c301c0b6e07.png[/img]

notes.title: Broadcasting Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Our First Broadcast![/h1]
We streamed Who Shuffled My Shapes? for the first time ever last Friday (6th May 2022) with the Steam Broadcasting feature!

There was a little bit of a learning curve for us to get things right as this was our first ever steam as an Indie Dev Studio but we feel like it went well. Thank you to the 70 of you who stopped by to have a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/1cb1092c5173e391c3b03fff92b9169baabef4f2.png[/img]

Our main goal with Broadcasting the game before release is two-fold.
[list]
[*] Firstly - We need to QA our game build before it goes live and so it's a good opportunity for us to complete the testing whilst showing the game off to you.
[*] Secondly - We like to be transparent with our players, we plan to use these streams to identify any issues and show off the progress we make week to week.
[/list]

If you miss the streams, you can check out our weekly Dev Vlogs over on YouTube, we record most of our work during the week and upload an edited video each Friday! [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaRcXeacWUTTXK2UAGQlEwg]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaRcXeacWUTTXK2UAGQlEwg[/url]


[h1]Rebroadcasting[/h1]
If you miss the broadcast but want to see us QA testing the game, don't worry, keep an eye on our Store Page from time to time to see when we are "live" as we are playing around with rebroadcasting the Friday streams throughout the week.

We hope to provide a full schedule at a later date.


[h1]Future Broadcasts[/h1]
We currently plan to stream every Friday around 2 PM UTC to keep up-to-date with the QA testing and update you on any changes we've made.

We have noted some issues with our first stream that we will address with future broadcasts. 
Rob has already worked on some store page assets to fill in the blank space around the stream and we know of the audio issues we had in stream 1.

A post will be made prior to the stream to confirm the exact times in the event of any changes/delays. 


Thanks again to those who stopped by for our first steam!
